Lightning wallet update:
- Select a channel to view its peer name, public key, current address, funding reference, status, and balance. Add/remove/close controls target that selection.
- Tap the balance unit to switch XBT, sats, and USDC across Lightning wallet balances and history.
- Fixed balance header, visible LND indicator, smaller Funding tab, green Receive/red Pay buttons, and compact gray on-chain actions.
- Camera QR invoice scanning, cancellation of unpaid receive invoices, and expandable gray canceled-invoice history.
- Settings activity panel stays below navigation. Tor support covers the embedded Lightning networking paths and configured watchtowers.

Please check layout, channel selection, QR scanning, and persistence on your iPhone. A watchtower must be configured; Tor alone does not register one. The exchange quote request still uses a direct HTTPS connection. Keep your recovery backup current.
